name: STT Fairview Data Center Campus
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres Philippines
notes: Flagship Quezon City/Fairview campus; STT GDC says first phase was on track for Q2 2025 and full build-out is 124 MW IT capacity; design certification announced in September 2025.

name: STT Makati Data Center
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres Philippines
notes: Upgraded Makati facility, formerly Globe MK2; STT GDC states total IT load capacity is over 5 MW after opening Data Hall F.

name: VITRO Makati 2 Expansion
notes: Makati 2 expansion added 12 MW and brought the facility to about 3,360 racks and 20 MW total power capacity.

name: Beeinfotech The HIVE Hybrid Data Center
notes: Pasig/Bridgetowne hybrid colocation facility; operator site shows the facility is open, while data-center directories list about 20 MW power capacity.

name: Converge Paranaque Hyperscale Data Center
developer: Converge ICT Solutions Inc. / unnamed multinational partner
notes: Converge disclosed a 49 MW hyperscaler-dedicated project on a 1.4-hectare Paranaque site; later public evidence of completion was not found during this pass.

name: Ilocos Norte Provincial Data Center
developer: Department of Information and Communications Technology / Provincial Government of Ilocos Norte
notes: DICT Ilocos Region launched Ilocos Norte's first data center at the provincial capitol extension building in Laoag as a regional cloud, colocation, web-hosting, and disaster-response hub.

name: CEZA Data Center and Telecommunication Facility Upgrade
notes: CEZA project in Santa Ana, Cagayan; RDC monitoring notes identify the data center and telecom facility upgrade as an infrastructure project serving ecozone locators' connectivity demand.

name: Converge Angeles Data Center
notes: AI-ready Angeles City, Pampanga data center housing Converge Cloud sovereign cloud infrastructure; trade press and official company material state 12 MW capacity.

name: VITRO Clark Data Center
notes: Clark Freeport Zone facility serving Northern Luzon colocation and Metro Manila disaster-recovery demand; directories list 8 MW and TIA registry confirms the facility identity.

name: Pax Silica / New Clark City AI and Hyperscale Data Center Hub
developer: Pax Silica Initiative / proposed investors; BCDA site owner
notes: BCDA initially announced New Clark City as an AI hub under the Pax Silica Initiative, but on 2026-08-11 BCDA stated large AI and hyperscale data centers would not locate there because electricity supply is insufficient.

name: Camarines Norte Green Data Center
developer: Polish, American, and Filipino investor consortium / PEZA investment lead
notes: PEZA-related investment lead for a EUR60 million data center in Camarines Norte integrating renewable energy and water desalination; treated as planned because no permit or construction evidence was found.

name: Mandaon, Masbate Municipal Data Center
developer: LGU Mandaon / DOST Bicol Small Enterprise Technology Upgrading Program
notes: DOST Bicol lists PHP1 million support to LGU Mandaon under a project titled Establishment of Data Center in Mandaon, Masbate; municipal/government scale, not hyperscale.

name: VITRO Cebu 2 Data Center
notes: Mandaue City facility; VITRO site describes Cebu 2 as the biggest purpose-built data center outside Luzon with 6,082 sqm colocation space and 12.3 MW total IT power.

name: Converge Mandaue P1 Data Center
notes: PHP1 billion six-story Mandaue, Cebu data center planned with initial 300 racks; later article said Converge was on course to finish in 2024, but no primary completion source found during this pass.

name: DOST Eastern Visayas Project SARAi Data Center
developer: Department of Science and Technology Eastern Visayas
notes: DOST said a data center would be established at its regional office to collect and process agricultural data for Project SARAi; included as a public-sector regional data center, not commercial colocation.

name: DICT GovNet Zamboanga City Data Center
developer: Department of Information and Communications Technology
notes: GovNet rollout connected 88 Zamboanga City nodes to an operational, secured 24/7 government data center; source does not disclose capacity or detailed facility location.
